title: Butler University Enters National Universities Category, Earns Top 20 Ranking for Undergraduate Teaching
summary_en: Butler University has earned a No. 19 national ranking for Undergraduate Teaching in the 2027 U.S. News & World Report Best Colleges Rankings, one of four areas in which Butler ranks among the Top 60 universities in the nation. This recognition comes in a milestone year for Butler as the University enters the National Universities…
